环境管理体系.原文: All factories pass the ISO 14001 certification, 100.00%（第11页）

碳管理体系建设.值: Conducted corporate carbon inventory in accordance with ISO 14064; Obtained ISO 14067 carbon footprint certification; GHG emissions reduction targets validated by SBTi in 2025
碳管理体系建设.原文: Conducted corporate carbon inventory in accordance with ISO 14064.（第11页）；Obtained ISO 14067 carbon footprint certification.（第11页）；Zhende Medical's emission reduction targets were validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) in 2025, making us the first manufacturing enterprise in China's medical device industry to have its targets validated by this authoritative international initiative.（第20页）

碳排放抵消与同比变化.值: Reduced absolute total GHG emissions (scope 1 & scope 2) by 8.3% compared to last year
碳排放抵消与同比变化.原文: Reduced absolute total GHG emissions (scope 1 & scope 2) by 8.3% compared to last year（第11页）

能源类型和强度.值: Total energy consumption was 4,533.49 tce; Renewable electricity percentage 23.99%
能源类型和强度.原文: the Company's total energy consumption was 4,533.49 tce; Renewable electricity percentage 23.99%（第21页）

节能目标与改造情况.值: Launched 17 energy-saving and emission reduction projects covering waste heat recovery, power system optimization, intelligent control, lighting upgrades and photovoltaic power generation; Committed to reducing absolute Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions by 42% by 2030 from a 2023 base year, and Scope 3 GHG emissions by 25% by 2030 from a 2023 base year
节能目标与改造情况.原文: The Company systematically planned and launched 17 energy-saving and emission reduction projects covering key areas such as waste heat recovery, power system optimization, intelligent control, lighting upgrades and photovoltaic power generation.（第21页）；Commit to reducing absolute Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions (from direct fuel combustion and purchased electricity/heat) by 42% by 2030 from a 2023 base year. Commit to reducing absolute Scope 3 GHG emissions (from upstream procurement, logistics and other value chain activities) by 25% by 2030 from a 2023 base year.（第20页）

供应商碳培训及考核情况.值: Held a supplier empowerment workshop in Shaoxing under the theme 'Symbiosis - Sharing - Co-progress'; The Procurement Department invited suppliers to participate in quarterly ESG communication and development training sessions.
供应商碳培训及考核情况.原文: In August 2025, Zhende Medical held a supplier empowerment workshop in Shaoxing under the theme 'Symbiosis - Sharing - Co-progress'.（第43页）；The Procurement Department invited suppliers to participate in quarterly ESG communication and development training sessions.（第11页）

供应商碳披露及评价要求.值: Established a Supplier ESG Scorecard, incorporating ESG performance into the annual supplier assessment system; Collected suppliers' certifications and reports on social responsibility, environmental protection, corporate governance and other aspects.
供应商碳披露及评价要求.原文: During the reporting period, the Company formally established and implemented a Supplier ESG Scorecard, incorporating ESG performance into the annual supplier assessment system.（第43页）；Collected suppliers' certifications and reports on social responsibility, environmental protection, corporate governance and other aspects.（第11页）

绿色物流.值: Integrated Shipping Planning and Freight Rates: automatically retrieves unshipped orders from SAP, intelligently consolidates logistics batches, and calls external data interfaces in real time to compare freight rates and automatically recommend the most cost-effective shipping solution.
绿色物流.原文: By developing new transaction codes, the system automatically retrieves unshipped orders from SAP, intelligently consolidates logistics batches, and calls external data interfaces in real time to compare freight rates and automatically recommend the most cost-effective shipping solution.（第17页）

供应链碳风险传导影响评估.值: Established a full-cycle risk management process based on multi-dimensional indicators such as purchase value and dependency, enabling systematic identification, assessment and mitigation of risks related to supply chain disruptions, compliance and other issues.
供应链碳风险传导影响评估.原文: During the reporting period, the Company formulated and issued the Supplier Risk Management Measures and established a full-cycle risk management process based on multi-dimensional indicators such as purchase value and dependency. This enables systematic identification, assessment and mitigation of risks related to supply chain disruptions, compliance and other issues, safeguarding the continuity of production and operations.（第42页）
